nodes.g: Tahrea = "cunning" a Benjamite, son of Micah in the line of Saul
Jehoadah = "Jehovah has adorned" a descendant of Saul through Jonathan
Jarah = "forested" a descendant of Saul, son of Micah, great grandson of Mephibosheth
Merib-baal = "Baal is my advocate" another name for Mephibosheth
to settle down, abide, dwell, tabernacle, reside
Eshbaal = "a man of Baal" the fourth son of Saul, also called Ishbosheth
